key.name: grouping-enabled
key.summary: Group notifications by the sending app
key.description: When off, every sending process gets its own stack, exactly as GNOME does without this extension.

key.name: max-per-source
key.description: How many notifications one merged stack keeps before the oldest is dropped. 10 is the GNOME limit; only lower values can be chosen.

key.name: ui-guards
key.summary: Work around two GNOME notification-list defects
key.description: Keeps a collapsed stack from freezing the whole list, and keeps closing one card from closing the stack. Turn off only to compare with unpatched GNOME; the guards are meant to be removed once GNOME fixes the defects.

key.name: isolate-apps
key.summary: Apps that keep their own stacks
key.description: App names listed here are never merged, each sender process stays separate. Names are matched after trimming and lower-casing, and a trailing .desktop is ignored.
